note: Models for Slop Upscale (upscale/). Converted to ONNX by vendor/models/tools/upscale-fsrcnn.py and upscale-realesrgan.py from the official weights listed here; each conversion is checked against the source framework before it is written. bundled: true ships with the site; bundled: false is an opt-in download through Get more (shared/library). Files are checked against sha256 on every load. Licence texts sit next to each model.

models.name: FSRCNN x2 (Fast)

models.trained: T91 and General100 (per the source README)

models.licenceNote: The code (xinntao/Real-ESRGAN) is BSD-3-Clause. The weights are published in the same repository (release v0.1.0) under that licence; no separate weights licence is given. Trained on DF2K and OST data, which is not redistributed here.
models.convertedWith: vendor/models/tools/upscale-realesrgan.py (PyTorch 2.14, ONNX opset 17, checked against PyTorch: max error 1e-6)
